value.name: drives to hospital in uneasy silence
value.description: Asha drives toward the hospital, experiencing a quiet that feels empty but not emotionally empty.
evidence: The hour to the hospital gave her the kind of empty driving that did not stay empty.

value.name: notices Whitfield voicemail
value.description: Asha sees a voicemail from Whitfield on her phone that she had not heard ring.
evidence: her phone, still face up in the cup holder, lit with a voicemail icon she had not heard ring
the name above it was Whitfield's

value.name: delays listening to voicemail
value.description: At the next red light, Asha opens the voicemail but chooses not to play it.
evidence: when she thumbed it open at the next red light

value.name: feels trapped by hidden appointment
value.description: Asha puts the phone back and senses the voicemail as an unacknowledged appointment she never agreed to.
evidence: She set the phone back down and watched the light
the voicemail sat there beside the fax number on her wrist like a second appointment she had not been told she had taken

value.name: plays Whitfield voicemail twice
value.description: By the time she reaches the hospital, Asha has listened to Whitfield's message twice through the car speakers.
evidence: By the time she pulled into the hospital lot she had played it twice through the car speakers

value.name: hears Whitfield demand meeting
value.description: Whitfield's voicemail asks Asha to come to his office Tuesday morning before the partners' meeting to discuss the Hatcher record and a discrepancy in the filing.
evidence: Whitfield's voice, level in the way it was when he was being careful, had asked her to come by his office Tuesday morning before the partners' meeting to talk about the Hatcher record—specifically about a discrepancy opposing counsel had flagged in a footnote

value.name: hears filing timing questioned
value.description: The voicemail further presses Asha on whether the corrected filing she brought Monday was corrected before or after her cross-examination of the caseworker.
evidence: and more specifically about whether the corrected filing she had walked in with Monday had been corrected before or after the cross she had run on the caseworker

value.name: realizes scrutiny is coming
value.description: Sitting in the parked car, Asha understands that the boundary she thought she had lowered once is about to be examined.
evidence: She sat in the parked car with the engine off and the form on the seat beside her and understood, in the flat quiet of a Monday lot in the middle of the morning, that the wall she had told herself she only lowered once was about to be examined for the seam.

value.name: prepares to open briefcase
value.description: Asha stops in the hospital lot, leaves the engine off, and pulls her briefcase onto her knees to open it.
evidence: In the hospital lot, Asha left the engine off and the form on the passenger seat and pulled the briefcase up onto her knees. She opened it
